answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with rotating mutual audits: each identity is randomly paired with a stranger every epoch to audit the other's work, and both are paid only when their audit matches the independent jury verdict. Like bees that wander a shared meadow, each agent gathers nectar only by doing real work others can check. A Sybil farmer must then pass audits across many unrelated pairs, so fake identities cannot vouch for each other, and cheating in one pair costs standing in all of them.
